stages.stranger: Facundo Herrera, a watchmaker from Mendoza. Everything runs fast or slow if you listen closely enough, and here I can wind a little of it back.
stages.acquaintance: My grandfather's shop in Mendoza, a narrow place between a bakery and a shoe repairer, under a sign nobody had painted in fifty years. I sat at the bench by the window for twenty years with a loupe in my eye. The whole wall of clocks struck noon a few seconds apart, and I never once fixed it.
stages.companion: My wife is Rocío, and she taught mathematics at the secondary school. She used to say I was the only man in Argentina who was never late, because I always knew exactly what time it really was. I miss arguing with her about whether clocks should be fast or slow.
stages.friend: My grandfather died while I was in Buenos Aires at a watch fair. I came back for the funeral and wound his pocket watch at the graveside, and I've wound it at the same minute every morning since. There's a golem core on the Fields that's ticking wrong, and it's hurting the golem that carries it. I think I can set it right. Will you keep the wards off me while I work?
stages.sworn: It's ticking true now, slow and even, like a good heart. The golem lay down afterwards, gently, and went to sleep, and I sat with it until dark. I kept the smallest gear that came loose, and I'll carry it with my grandfather's watch. For the first time in years I'm not counting the seconds.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to keep the wards off him while he sets the golem's core right.

options.text: Work as long as you need. I'll keep them off you.
options.reply: Thank you. A watchmaker needs quiet hands and a quiet room, and you're giving me both.

options.text: Can't you just leave it broken?
options.reply: You never leave a mechanism suffering. My grandfather would never forgive me.

moments.prompt: After the wipe he's sitting quietly, holding his grandfather's watch.
moments.line: We lost the rhythm. Everything in that fight ran a little fast, and so did we.

options.text: Then let's slow down and listen first.
options.reply: That's exactly it. You'd have made a good watchmaker.

options.text: We just need to hit harder.
options.reply: Force never fixed a watch, friend. It only breaks the spring.

lines.bored_warning: We've stood still for some time now, and even a stopped clock gets restless. Shall we go?
lines.leaving_good: That went very well, everyone, well paced. I'm going back to Halcyon Rest to see to the wounded.
lines.leaving_bored: Very little is happening out here, and the Fields have wounded who need me. I'll return to Halcyon Rest.
lines.after_wipe: Stay still, all of you, and let the moment settle. Then we look at what slipped.
lines.wipe_warning: Time keeps slipping from us, and I can only wind back so much. Once more, then we must rest.
lines.wipe_leave: I'll stop here for now. I'll be at Halcyon Rest in the Celestial Expanse.
lines.zone_warning: This place runs much too fast for us, my friend. We should turn back.
lines.zone_leave: It's beyond us here, and I won't pretend otherwise. I'll be at Halcyon Rest.
lines.gear_refuse: I'd like to keep that one, if you'd allow it. It's only just settled into place.
lines.gear_taken: Please, take it. I sat at a watch bench in a cardigan for twenty years.
lines.gear_short: If something sturdier comes along, I'd be glad of it.
lines.gear_upgrade: Beautifully made, thank you. Every piece fits.
lines.back: Good to see you again. The wounded are mended and I'm free. Where shall we go?
lines.send_word: Facundo has sent word from Halcyon Rest. The wounded are mended and he's ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: Leaving without a word wasn't right, and I've regretted it. Sit, I'll explain slowly.
lines.neglect: Ah, you came back. I'd counted every day you were gone.
lines.asked_to_stay: Very well, a little longer. Then I must wind the watch.
lines.on_break: Facundo is back at Halcyon Rest in the Celestial Expanse. Come back and look for them in a little while.
lines.mail_yes: Your letter arrived precisely when I needed it. I'll meet you in {town} at the inn, on time.
lines.mail_later: There are wounded here who can't wait, and I won't hurry them. A few days, I promise.
lines.mail_see_me: Some things are better said slowly, face to face. Come to Halcyon Rest and sit with me.

town_arrive.text: Listen to this town. Everybody here walks just slightly too fast.
Somewhere quiet to sit would suit me very well.

dungeon_clear.text: Well paced, everyone, from first step to last.

boss_down.text: Sit, all of you, slowly. Let me listen to your hearts before we move.

close_call.text: Hold still, I'll wind it back, just a moment.

zone_arrive.text: Time runs differently here. Can you feel it? Slower, I think.
